digest.component_or_area: Git version floor enforcement and test gating
propositions: Git merge-tree test regression requires Git 2.38+ but the floor version is not declared or enforced, risking silent test skips on older clients
The repository must establish an explicit Git 2.38+ version floor across contributor documentation and CI to avoid vacuous test coverage
Enforcement must fail loudly at session start rather than skip conditionally, preventing the regression from silently not running for some contributors
Two-clone enrichment regression (bug 8185) must remain collected and executed on all gating CI environments without skip-based degradation

Implementation declares Git 2.38+ floor in single-sourced config file, enforces it in pytest session startup, gates CI runners, and includes non-vacuity checks to prevent module drift from emptying the guard
